title: Fundraising 2026/27

previousYear.impact: Last year's fundraising is helping to fund new KS1 playground equipment, scheduled for installation over the October half term in 2026.

priorities.title: Classroom visualisers
priorities.description: A visualiser for each classroom will help teachers demonstrate handwriting, share physical objects and show examples clearly to the whole class.

priorities.title: Additional playground equipment
priorities.description: Refreshing the equipment children use at playtime, replacing items that wear out through everyday use.

priorities.title: Additional iPads
priorities.description: Supporting the computing curriculum with more devices that work with the school's existing iPads and IT support.

priorities.title: Beekeeping suits
priorities.description: Additional suits in sizes for adults and older children will help extend beekeeping activities to KS2 pupils.

annualSupport: Enrichment experiences, including workshops and activities
